title.narrative: H.O.P.E in Action: Harnessing Opportunities for the Promotion of Women's Empowerment

description.narrative: Among the population groups affected by the 2023 Kahramanmaras earthquakes, individuals facing intersecting inequalities particularly women require targeted policies to ensure that Türkiye’s earthquake response truly leaves no one behind. Through the design and implementation of a model project, the aim is to equip women with the tools, resources, and opportunities they need for self-sufficiency and full inclusion in society. Taking a holistic approach, the project combines vocational training, business continuity services, and employment support to help break cycles of dependency and foster a more equitable and inclusive society.The project is structured around three main outputs: I) Participatory Needs Assessment and Strategic Partnerships Established. II) Women-Led Small Businesses Strengthened through Provision of Business Continuity Support. III) Vocational Training Programs and Employment Incentives for Women in Earthquake-Affected Areas Developed and Delivered.

condition.narrative: Social and environmental sustainability will be enhanced through application of the UNDP Social and Environmental Standards (http://www.undp.org/ses) and related Accountability Mechanism (http://www.undp.org/secu-srm).
